background: IELS Circle is IELSco's free English speaking club and community across Southeast Asia (SITE).
It runs on two fixed weekly slots (Wednesday 19:00 WIB, Saturday 13:00 WIB) with a curated topic rotation: speaking, scholarships, careers, ASEAN, study and work abroad (SITE).
Cohorts add structure: the Oct–Dec 2026 cohort (registration closed 9 Oct) runs 8 weekly themes from daily conversation to podcasts and lectures, ending with Graduation Day on 12 Dec (SITE).
Circle is also the entry point to IELSco's other projects: it is included in IELS Course and is the planned channel for GIF applicant education (SITE, OS).
